This paper introduces PHYBench, an original and challenging benchmark with 500 carefully curated physics problems for evaluating the reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

PHYBench was constructed with strong support from the School of Physics at Peking University, Ministry of Education Physics 101 Plan, and National Science Foundation of China under contract No. 12425505, 12235001, U2230402.
In total, more than a hundred students in the School have participated in this project and made valuable contributions.
